notes.triage: The scripts' triage list is applied to every per-mouse-day series: George (crossed into the other enclosure) is absent; Anubis from day 5 (died), Rae from day 2, Hare from day 2, Isis from day 3 and Rose on day 10 are null. Gilmour (lost on day 10) is kept, so day 10 is null for him where a script needs data that day.
notes.correction: 185 ALLTRIAL_MOVEBOUT.csv bouts on 27 mouse-days carry duration_s in minutes (R difftime units) and are converted to seconds. Panels that use MOVEBOUT durations change: S2B/S3E (% time in top zone: up to 2.2 points for a mouse-day, at most 0.08 points in a group mean) and the PAS panels 2D/S2D/S3B/S3C (63 mice change, max |change| 1.93; day-10 sign changes: Marie (F) +0.093 -> -0.001, Megan (F) -0.136 -> +0.258). No male changes sign, so the PAS splits in 2F and S2F are unchanged. Nothing else reads MOVEBOUT durations; the published figures used the uncorrected values.
notes.rfid: ALLTRIAL_RFID_DATA.csv (9,153,983 reads) is already triaged, so the scripts' filters remove nothing here (0 triage, 0 Jeeves). The Jeeves filter (read_tag == '982.126057708741' from 07/24/2020, his second tag falling out) cannot match: the deposited read_tag keeps 4 decimals ('982.1261'), so his two tags are indistinguishable; the deposited zone-ownership table shows the published run kept these reads too.
notes.2A: reads[trial][name] = RFID reads per day (1-10) x zone (1-8). Heatmaps (2A, 3A, S2A, S3A) plot log10(count) per mouse, zones laid out 7 8 / 5 6 / 3 4 / 1 2 top to bottom; a zone with 1 read shows as 0, like an empty one. No mean.
notes.2B: rank1[trial][day][zone] = % of the zone's male-sourced reads that day from the male with most reads (null: no male reads, or a tie for first, which R's rank() scores 1.5). Mean +- SE over trial x zone x day cells, pooled across the trials of a strain (C57 n = 27-32, WD n = 22-24 per day). Matches the deposited ALLTRIAL_RFID_zone_ownership.csv and the published points.
notes.2C: dyadic.MM = every GBI association bout (= rows of ALLTRIAL_MOVEBOUT_GBI_concat) with exactly 2 males present (any number of females), 0 s set to 1 s; FM (S2E) = exactly 1 male and 1 female; FF (S3F) = exactly 2 females (any number of males); FM/FF drop 0 s rows. t = 1 + days since the trial's first GBI event (not noon-aligned), min = duration / 60. Points: {'MM': {'C57': 1829, 'WD': 291}, 'FM': {'C57': 10103, 'WD': 5795}, 'FF': {'C57': 8389, 'WD': 3544}}. Scatter of single bouts, no mean. The published y axes stop at 150 min (MM) and 40 min (FM, FF), which hides 0 MM, 7 FM and 5 FF bouts that are included here. Script: gbi_concat_2mouse_MM_FF_MF_bout_durations_freqs.R (the edge-list version, edge_MM_FF_MF_dyadic_durations_freqs.R, is not the published one).
notes.S2C: dyadic_freq.MM[trial] = MM bouts per day. Mean +- SE over trials (C57 n = 4, WD n = 3). The published means skip trial-days with no MM bouts (R's tally() has no zero rows): T004 d4, T005 d6, T005 d8. Drop zeros to reproduce the figure. FM and FF counts use the same rows as the FM/FF points (no published panel).
notes.2D: daily.pas = cumulative priority access score, recomputed from MOVEBOUT with corrected durations (with the deposited durations this reproduces priority_access_scores_*.csv exactly). Each day a mouse scores the sum over zones of its share of its own sex's time there, minus 1 unless it held > 50% of some zone; an unseen day scores -1. 2D/S2D (males), S3B/S3C (females): individual lines and densities of the day-10 values (geom_density(adjust = 0.25)).
notes.2E: winrate = per male that owned zones, won / (won + lost) displacements at home (a zone it owned that day, by RFID reads) and away, over all 10 days; only males with both (n = 32). Individual pairs of points; the script's mean +- SE is over these males with both strains pooled.
notes.2F: daily.fm_time_cum_min = cumulative minutes in associations with >= 1 female present (GBI summary), males only, over the days the male has any GBI rows (null otherwise). mice[].pas_group splits by the PAS on the male's last scored day (day 10; Anubis day 4), > 0 'pos', <= 0 'neg'. Mean +- SE over males per strain x group, as the deposited script computes it. The published panel differs on days 1-4 and in one point: its means (reproduced from these values to within 0.1 min) instead (a) let a male in only from his first day with > 0 min, (b) carry a value forward over a day without data (Gilmour, day 10: 574 instead of 603 for WD PAS > 0), and (c) split by day-10 PAS, which leaves out Anubis (no day 10).
notes.S2B: daily.top_zone_pct = % of the day's MOVEBOUT time in the mouse's most-used zone over all 10 days (not that day's top zone). Mean +- SE over mice with bouts that day, males (S2B) and females (S3E). Corrected durations; see 'correction'.
notes.S2F: daily.zones_visited of males, split by day-10 PAS (> 0 vs <= 0), strains pooled; Anubis (no day-10 PAS) is left out. Mean +- SE over males.
notes.3B: daily.zones_visited = zones with >= 1 RFID read that day; 0 on days without reads up to the mouse's last day with reads, null after it. Mean +- SE over mice per strain x sex.
notes.3C: daily.zones_cum = distinct zones visited so far, from the mouse's first day with reads, carried to day 10. Mean +- SE over mice per strain x sex.
notes.3D: daily.cagemate_pref = cagemate_time_pct minus the % expected by chance: the strain's mean number of cagemates still present that day / (females present in the trial that day - 1) x 100 (Rae, Isis and Rose's absences adjusted as in the script). Mean +- SE over females with any female-female association that day.
notes.S3G: daily.cagemate_time_pct = % of a female's female-female association time (edge list, summed per partner per day) spent with females from her pre-release cage, rounded to 4 significant digits as in the script (0 female-days would be duplicated by R's unique() step). Mean +- SE over females with any female-female association that day.
notes.S3D: daily.distance_m = minimum distance: every change of zone in the mouse's read sequence (whole trial, run-length encoded) adds the straight-line distance between zone centres to the day of the change. Zone centres (m, from 1_create_ALLTRIAL_RFID.R): 1 (3.75, 7.6), 2 (11.25, 7.6), 3 (3.75, 15.2), 4 (11.25, 15.2), 5 (3.75, 22.8), 6 (11.25, 22.8), 7 (3.75, 30.4), 8 (11.25, 30.4). Days without reads are 0, not null. Mean +- SE over mice per strain x sex.
notes.4A: comp_hours[strain][males][females] = total time spent in zones holding that many males and females, per trial (hours; C57 / 4 trials, WD / 3), from the GBI summary rows divided by group size as in the script. 0 = never observed (white in the figure). Not a mean +- SE.
notes.4B: From the GBI summary, per mouse-day: alone_pct (only mouse in the zone), samesex_pct (4C; >= 2 mice, none of the other sex), oppsex_pct (S4A; >= 1 of each sex present), all as % of the mouse's time in the GBI that day, and oppsex_social_pct (S4B; opposite-sex time as % of time with any other mouse; null if none). Mean +- SE over mice per strain x sex.
notes.4F: net[trial] = components and edge density of each trial-day SRI network (ALLTRIAL_SNA_net_stats.csv as deposited). Mean +- SE over trials (C57 n = 4, WD n = 3).
notes.4H: daily.degree (4H) and daily.pagerank (S4D) from ALLTRIAL_SNA_vertex_stats.csv as deposited. Mean +- SE over mice per strain x sex.
notes.S4C: daily.novel_mice_cum = number of different mice met so far (co-present in a zone in the GBI), CORRECTED: a pair's first meeting is the earliest GBI row holding both, by time. daily.novel_mice_cum_published = the published series: gbi_cumulative_novel_mice_met.R takes the first row of the GBI file holding both, and the file is sorted by zone before time, so for 346 of 1532 focal-partner pairs the meeting is dated to a later day than it happened. Day-10 totals are identical; days 1-9 of the published series run low by up to 4.3 mice in a group mean (C57 females, day 2: 4.51 published vs 8.79 corrected). Mice that met nobody are null. Mean +- SE over mice per strain x sex.
